description: Fetch the fully rendered HTML of any web page through the ScrapeUnblocker API (https://docs.scrapeunblocker.com), bypassing anti-bot protection (Cloudflare, DataDome, PerimeterX, Akamai, Shape). Use when a normal fetch is blocked (403/429, captcha) or the page needs a real browser. Returns raw HTML. To read or summarise a page, fetch_markdown is much smaller. To click, type or scroll before capture, use browse_page.

proxy_country.description: Optional ISO country code to route through, e.g. 'US'.

sleep_seconds.description: Extra seconds to wait after load.

name: fetch_html
title: Fetch page HTML
